name: KnowBe4
summary: KnowBe4 sells security awareness training with simulated phishing, priced per seat per month on a 3-year term. Foundation starts at $2.40 per seat for 25 to 50 seats and Advanced at $3.75, and both fall with volume to $1.63 and $2.79 at 501 to 1,000 seats. Above 1,000 seats the price is a quote.

facts.text: KnowBe4 lists unlimited phishing security tests on both Foundation and Advanced, and says Foundation has 200+ pieces of content while Advanced has 1000+.
The product page names training completion and phishing simulation pass rates over time as tracked metrics, and cites 60+ built-in reports and executive dashboards.
Foundation includes a limited number of Smart Groups, while Advanced includes unlimited Smart Groups.
Per the pricing page, list prices may change at any time, may vary by region and exclude taxes. The USD figures here come from its default United States selection.

plans.name: SAT Foundation
plans.notes: 3-year term. Per seat per month: $2.13 for 51 to 100 seats, $1.97 for 101 to 250, $1.80 for 251 to 500, $1.63 for 501 to 1,000. Quote above 1,000 seats

plans.name: SAT Advanced
plans.notes: 3-year term. Per seat per month: $3.40 for 51 to 100 seats, $3.19 for 101 to 250, $2.96 for 251 to 500, $2.79 for 501 to 1,000. Quote above 1,000 seats

hiddenCosts: Prices are shown for a 3-year term only, and the page lists no other term.
Add-ons cost extra, such as Third-Party Integrations at $1.20 per seat per month for 101 to 500 seats.
The lowest published band starts at 25 seats.
